purpose: Table 表格; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandTable](../../lib/src/components/table.dart), [IslandTableColumn](../../lib/src/components/table.dart), [IslandTablePagination](../../lib/src/components/table.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Stable row and column keys; opaque cells. Table owns client slicing and gives one controlled value to Pagination. Nested actions do not invoke row callbacks.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. Table owns shared column geometry through explicitly registered render cells. Auto columns measure finite intrinsic widths; constraint-dependent content requires column.width. No widget subtree is inspected, rewritten or mounted twice. Fixed column.width and intrinsic preferredWidth are mutually exclusive; preferred widths shrink to minima before horizontal overflow. Header defaults do not wrap; explicit child properties win. Its composed Pagination explicitly uses AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd, preserving the reference trailing placement even when the inline row exceeds a narrow table viewport. A pending presentation-focus recovery survives benign host/theme rebuilds while its child/header owner is unchanged. New recovery ownership supersedes the previous request; replacement, removal, disposal, inactive view and explicit external destinations retain priority. Rebuilding alone does not cancel an otherwise valid request. Independent Card/Tag/Table child focus attaches to the existing caller Focus node, including a FocusScope; if no inherited focus exists it uses the existing manager root. A scope boundary must not silently place the child beneath the optional parent detector or paint parent focus over child focus. One shared ActionSurface owns this fork; no new scope or copied child subtree is introduced.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required. Passive and disabled controls do not advertise tap actions.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Loading fully occludes retained data with an opaque surface. Hidden cells expose no pointer, focus or semantics access; recovery reveals the same mounted cells.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. The loading indicator uses light.link on the opaque loading surface, including the first frame. Decorative48px empty chart follows pinned reference path; empty text remains the necessary message. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.then: Preferred columns shrink to finite intrinsic minima, fixed columns retain their contract, opaque content remains mounted and all rows share column geometry.
